description: Turn any document URL into clean Markdown for LLMs: web pages, PDFs, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx/.xls), OpenDocument, CSV, XML and plain text, up to 10 MB. Returns title, Markdown, links (for web pages) and character count. Private addresses are blocked; failures are not charged. Use to read one web page or document (PDF, Word, Excel) as Markdown. Answers may be cached for up to 10 minutes. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. In the free trial.

schemaVersion.description: Output version ("<tool>@<n>"): additive changes only within a version; a new number for anything breaking, the old one kept 90 days.

truncated.description: True if the Markdown was cut at 500,000 characters.
